newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola plans ad campaign for unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola plans ad campaign for unit - WSJ.

text.p: Coca-Cola plans to spend $50 million next year in an advertising campaign to promote the products of its Minute Maid division, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said the amount the company was planning to spend was triple what it had allotted for the division in 1996.
It said Coca-Cola was also planning to overhaul the division's product line and concentrate on selling juice made only from concentrate.
Minute Maid has been hurt by competition and bad distribution, it added.
